name: RestrictedFundAllocator
tagline: Every restricted dollar in the right fund – designate gifts, release restrictions with evidence and see net assets with and without donor restrictions.
description: A complete restricted-fund accounting app for nonprofits in one PCF control: a fund register by restriction class (unrestricted, board-designated, purpose, time, purpose & time, endowment), a designation queue that splits each gift across funds with suggestions from the donor's intent, releases from restriction with second approval, expense evidence, time-restriction and endowment rules, a time-restriction schedule, a net asset roll-forward with and without donor restrictions, and journal text for the ledger. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with built-in demo data.
features: Designation splits with remainder-to-operating, split equally, percentages and over-designation checks
Fund suggestion from the donor's stated intent
Releases blocked for endowment principal, unrestricted funds, funds on hold, wrong reasons, time restrictions not yet ended and amounts above the available balance
Expense evidence for purpose releases; donor consent reference for donor-approved changes
Second approver above a configurable threshold; small releases post directly
Gift and release posting with journal numbers and Dr/Cr JournalText
Return / refund with reversal of posted lines when the money is still available
Fund hold / close / reopen with checks
Undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts, notes history
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
